name: prompt-optimizer
description: Keep long requests intact with deterministic requirement custody.

interface.longDescription: Turn long or messy requests into reviewable instructions while preserving explicit requirements, separating assumptions, and flagging scope drift in a deterministic local Requirement Custody Ledger.
defaultPrompt: Keep every requirement in this long request while making it easier to use.
Check whether this optimized request lost or invented anything.
Show the explicit requirements, assumptions, and unresolved decisions.
